spellbook.finance/limitations: This is evidence retrieval. It does not rank cards, estimate unavailable prices, or recommend a purchase.
English and unknown language rows fail the Japanese acceptance gate. A source is unavailable when it lacks explicit Japanese language evidence in the stored record.

Accepted prices require one printing joined by provider product, SKU, language, finish and condition. populationComplete and truncated state read and output caps; no combined provider yield is calculated.

description: Read physical Japanese-language Riftbound observations, separate from English cards sold in Japan. Returns exact SKU language, finish, condition, price kind, source links, actual price capture timestamps, freshness policy, per-source eligible denominators and nullable acceptance rates. ManaPool is unsupported_game. Distinguishes unavailable, stale, completed eligible zero and accepted evidence. TCG Market is a provider statistic, not a completed sale or guaranteed resale proceeds. asOf is query time. An empty result never implies a market price of zero or proves market-wide coverage.
name: spellbook_riftbound_japanese_comparables
